# Toolbox date parser reference cases

Copied unchanged from genro-org/genro-toolbox at
`dfb7322a53a2f9030d6baaadfbb87028559672fd` (Apache-2.0, Softwell S.r.l.).
`period_parser_corpus.json` contains 2796 legacy-derived cases; overlay the
432 declared `period_parser_divergences.json` cases by (text, locale, workdate),
exactly as Toolbox tests/test_period_parser.py does. These are upstream expected
results, not generated by the JavaScript implementation. No live dependency on
Toolbox, its filesystem checkout, GenroPy or a server is needed to run the suite.

On refresh, inspect the upstream revision and semantic changes first; replace both
files together, update this provenance and verify every case. Do not rewrite
expected outcomes merely to make a JavaScript test pass.
